size.description: Korean shoe size in millimeters, converted from what is printed on a visible label. Null when no size marking is readable. Never estimate from the apparent length of the shoe.

sizeLabelText.description: The size marking exactly as printed, before conversion. e.g. 'US 9 / UK 8 / EUR 42 / 27cm'. Null when nothing is readable.

modelCode.description: Style or article code printed on a label. e.g. '1183A353-101'. Null when not readable.

brand.description: Brand as confirmed or corrected by a label or logo in these images. Null when no label or logo settles it.

modelName.description: Model name as confirmed or corrected by a label. Null when no label settles it.

boxIncluded.description: True only when a shoe box is visible in the images. False only when the seller's photos clearly show the shoes without any box in a context where a box would be shown. Null otherwise.

evidence.description: One entry for every non-null field above. A field without evidence must be null.

imageIndex.description: 0-based index of the image this was seen in.

observedText.description: Characters literally readable in the image. Null when the evidence is not text. For size, this must be non-null.

observation.description: In Korean, one sentence stating where in the image this was read.

sourceChunkId.description: Always null. Reserved for citing reference data supplied in the prompt.

unreadable.description: Fields left null, with the reason. In Korean.
